critical_code_review_comments: CareRelief buildWaLink does not prepend a country code or validate digit length — if a user stored only '888' as their emergency phone (observed with the pre-existing jane@example.com user), wa.me/888 is produced. Consider enforcing a sensible minimum length (and perhaps defaulting to Indian country code 91) in the link builder, or at minimum validating emergency_contact_phone on save.
